originalTitle: Ukraine war briefing: Air ceasefire talk ahead of Trump-Zelenskyy meeting
summary: Romania summons Russian ambassador after shooting down three drones; Zelenskyy to meet Andy Burnham in UK. What we know on day 1,615
content: Ukrainian and US officials have discussed a proposal to offer Russia an air ceasefire, the Reuters news agency has reported, citing a Ukrainian source. Volodymyr Zelenskyy is due to meet Donald Trump, the US president, in Washington on Tuesday. The Kremlin spokesperson, Dmitry Peskov, said on ⁠Sunday that Russia considered it premature to comment on any such ceasefire proposal. “We do not know how credible these reports are or where they come from. These are newspaper reports and nothing more. Therefore, it is premature to comment on them at this stage,” the Interfax news agency quoted Peskov as saying. “We have heard statements that some new formulas may be possible. We still need to learn more about them … What happens next will depend on how closely they correspond to our interests.” Romania said it was summoning Russia’s ambassador after the Nato member’s military shot down a third drone in as many days. A Romanian F-16 fighter jet shot down the drone over the Black Sea, five minutes after it entered the country’s airspace, said Romania’s defence minister, Radu Miruță. The foreign minister, Oana Țoiu, condemned “repeated violations”. The Romanian president, Nicușor Dan, said that according to an investigation, a drone shot down on Friday was a “Shahed model used by the Russian Federation in its war of aggression against Ukraine”. Investigations into drones shot down on Saturday and Sunday continued, he said. The Golden Leo, an international cargo vessel, sank off the coast of ⁠Ukraine’s Black Sea port of Odesa on Sunday, a week after Ukrainian ⁠officials said ⁠it had been struck by Russian forces. Nine ⁠crew members were killed in the attack while eight ‌were evacuated to safety. The ‌ship had left the ‌port of Chornomorsk with a cargo of corn when it was shelled by Russian forces on 19 July. Russia’s defence ministry ⁠said on Sunday that its forces had ⁠struck Ukrainian ⁠ports and shipping. Russia claimed the container terminal ‌at Chornomorsk, near ‌Odesa, handled “military cargoes”. Russia launched seven ballistic missiles and 136 drones at Ukraine overnight into Sunday, the Ukrainian air force said. In the northern Ukrainian city of Chernihiv, a Russian drone hit ⁠a supermarket, killing two people – including a nine-year-old child – and wounding 25, emergency services said. In the eastern city of Kharkiv, one person was killed and 16 others required medical attention ‌after a daytime drone attack, said the mayor, Ihor Terekhov. A glide bomb attack killed one person and wounded six in the southern city of Zaporizhzhia, said the regional governor, Ivan Fedorov. In Kyiv, a fire broke out on the seventh and eighth floors of a multi-storey apartment block in a central district after ‌a missile attack, said the mayor, Vitali Klitschko. Three people were wounded. In Sloviansk, Donetsk region, the national oil and gas company Naftogaz said two of its employees died in a Russian attack while trying to help residents affected by an earlier strike. Russia said ⁠areas of Ukraine under Moscow’s control had also come under attack, with four people killed in a Ukrainian drone strike in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Horlivka. Twelve ⁠people, including two children, were ⁠injured ⁠in drone attack on ⁠the Russian city of Belgorod, close ⁠to Ukraine’s ‌border, regional authorities ‌said early on Monday. Ukraine denies targeting civilians. Volodymyr Zelenskyy will become Andy Burnham’s first overseas visitor as prime minister, in a visit that Burnham said underlined Britain’s “unwavering” backing for Ukraine, Peter Walker writes. Less than two weeks after Keir Starmer travelled to Kyiv for the final foreign visit of his prime ministership, Zelenskyy will on Monday join Burnham at a naval base where Ukrainian forces have been receiving training. According to statistics released by No 10, since Russia’s full invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, total UK support for the country has totalled £25bn, including £16bn in military assistance. Burnham and Zelenskyy are due to discuss joint projects including Stone Cloak, an electronic jammer for which the UK has shared the intellectual property, allowing Ukraine to use the system immediately to prevent Russia shooting down Ukrainian drones. Since being proven on the Ukrainian frontline, the jammers are due to be fitted to new UK weaponry, including cruise missiles.
chineseTitle: 乌克兰战争简报：特朗普与泽伦斯基会面前进行空中停火谈判
chineseSummary: 罗马尼亚击落三架无人机后召见俄罗斯大使；泽连斯基将在英国会见安迪·伯纳姆。第 1,615 天我们所知道的
chineseContent: 路透社援引乌克兰消息人士的话说，乌克兰和美国官员已经讨论了向俄罗斯提出空中停火的提议。弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基将于周二在华盛顿会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周日表示，俄罗斯认为对任何此类停火提议发表评论还为时过早。国际文传电讯社援引佩斯科夫的话说：“我们不知道这些报道有多可信，也不知道它们来自哪里。这些只是报纸报道，仅此而已。因此，现阶段对它们发表评论还为时过早。” “我们听说一些新的公式可能是可行的。我们仍然需要更多地了解它们......接下来发生的事情将取决于它们与我们利益的契合程度。”罗马尼亚表示，在北约成员国军队几天内击落第三架无人机后，罗马尼亚正在召见俄罗斯大使。罗马尼亚国防部长拉杜·米鲁沙 (Radu Miruşă) 表示，这架无人机进入该国领空五分钟后，一架罗马尼亚 F-16 战斗机在黑海上空将其击落。外交部长瓦纳·索伊谴责“一再侵犯行为”。罗马尼亚总统尼库索尔·丹表示，根据调查，周五被击落的一架无人机是“俄罗斯联邦在侵略乌克兰战争中使用的沙赫德型号”。他说，对周六和周日被击落的无人机的调查仍在继续。周日，一艘国际货船“金狮子”号在乌克兰黑海港口敖德萨海岸沉没，一周前乌克兰官员称该船遭到俄罗斯军队袭击。九名船员在袭击中丧生，八人被疏散至安全地带。这艘船载着一批玉米离开切尔诺莫斯克港，遭到炮击。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
